name: exercise_log
description: Individual exercises within training activities. References activities table via activity_id.

columns.name: activity_id
columns.description: Foreign key to activities table: YYYYMMDD_type_index (e.g., 20260115_str_1)

columns.name: exercise_name
columns.description: Exercise name in snake_case (e.g., leg_press, romanian_deadlift)

columns.name: set_number
columns.description: Set number within this exercise for this activity

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Path to the markdown file this was extracted from
